name: Apart Rubin
beschreibung:
Overview

Apart Rubin is a holiday apartment in Serfaus in the Austrian federal state of Tyrol. It is located at Malbrettweg 5 in the municipality of Serfaus in the district of Landeck. The accommodation is situated in a sunny and quiet location just a few steps from the centre of Serfaus, directly on the southern ski run and near the local swimming pool. This location offers direct access to the surroundings of the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis sun plateau. The house offers a selection of fully equipped holiday apartments that can be used independently of one another and have separate living areas.

History/Background

No reliable information about a specific founding history of the establishment is available in the sources examined. The property is registered as an apartment and holiday apartment facility and is listed in the offerings of the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis tourism association as well as on tirol.de. The names of the individual apartments refer to various minerals such as jade, malachite, calcite, amazonite, carnelian, amber, citrine and aventurine. This naming is evident from the published property descriptions of the accommodation, without any further historical facts being derivable from it.

Arrival

Apart Rubin can be reached via Malbrettweg 5 in 6534 Serfaus. The location directly on the southern ski run provides convenient transport links to the region's road network. Parking is available at the house. For guests arriving by public transport, accessibility is provided via the well-connected Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis region. Further details on timetables or specific public transport lines are not explicitly stated in the sources examined.

Tips

The quiet and sunny location makes Apart Rubin a starting point for activities in both summer and winter. In summer, hiking trails and other nature-related activities are the focus in the surrounding area, while in winter the ski slopes of the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis region are easily accessible. The immediate proximity to the swimming pool and the centre of Serfaus allows easy access to other facilities in the village. The holiday apartments offered are equipped with fully equipped kitchens, comfortably furnished rooms and balconies. In addition, the house offers shared facilities such as a sauna, a steam bath, an infrared cabin, a cold room, an experience shower, a ski room with boot dryer, a children's playroom, a washing machine and a dryer, as well as options for storing bicycles.
